readings: During the cycle when done is asserted, the FSM is in a dedicated DONE state and does not examine the input byte; the next byte is examined only in the following cycle.
During the cycle when done is asserted, the FSM has already returned to the search state and examines the input byte for in[3]=1, allowing a new message to start immediately after the third byte.
Synchronous reset has priority: if reset is high in the same cycle as the third byte, the FSM resets and done is not asserted in the following cycle.
The third byte is processed and done is asserted even if reset is high in that cycle, with reset only affecting the cycle after.
done is asserted for exactly one clock cycle (the cycle immediately after the third byte).
done remains asserted until the next message starts or reset is asserted.
done is reset to 0 when reset is active.
done is not explicitly reset and its value after reset is undefined until the first message.
